svg.title: Blocks, hashes and the chain
svg.desc: Three blocks left to right. Each holds the previous block's hash, its transactions and its own hash; arrows link each hash into the next block. Note: editing an old block breaks the later fingerprints, but consensus decides which history is accepted.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blocks are chained by the previous block's fingerprint

svg.text: Illustration: H(…) means a hash (content fingerprint), not a real value
